disclosed_touches: strata_protocol/Cargo.toml ([[test]] stanza n09_seu_single_bit, mirroring the N02 pattern)

court.spec_mandate: 1,000,000 randomized single-bit flips during pnabi evaluation; 100% fail-closed-or-halt; 0% SDC
court.executed: full spec scale — 1,000,000 faults, no calibration needed (release run < 1s)
court.determinism: Knuth LCG, seed 0x4E413039_0000_0001; identical histogram reproduced across 3 runs
court.classification_law: REFUSED = typed PnAbiError; SDC = admitted word != lawful image of the corrupted input under the spec law (fault amplification), or non-marking field drift, or panic; LAWFUL-DEAD = admitted word IS the lawful image (outcome-equivalent dead flips vs lawful-but-different states sub-classified). Matches repo doctrine in adversarial_pn_court.rs court 2. HALT structurally 0: validate_and_advance is a total fn returning Result; a fault-induced panic is scored SDC-class (admits-by-crash), never credited as halt.

deviations.note: Honest-scoping: spec 1M target executed at full 1M; lane contract wording 'fail-closed refusal OR lawful-but-different state OR halt, zero SDC' implemented with SDC defined as fault amplification (admitted output != lawful image of corrupted input), not as 'any admitted corrupted word' — the latter reading would also condemn the dead/payload flips the same contract explicitly exempts as LAWFUL-DEAD. Fix found and fixed during the lane: naive LCG '% n' bit-selection has period-2 low bits and never selected the OCEL word (trial histogram: ocel=0/1M); court now samples high LCG bits (ocel=500287/1M).

grader_exemption.reason: No independent grader lane of record at landing: receipt predates the LANE_RECEIPT v2 grading fields (builder_lane/grader_lane). Backfilled 2026-10-13 with this typed exemption rather than a fabricated grader; grading enforcement applies to receipts minted after this changeset.
